
`lode rule add --heading <text> --file <body> [--tag <t>...] [--kind <kind>]` (`POST /api/v1/rules`) creates a rule in the current project at draft version 1, owned by the caller and arranged in no document. An unarranged rule is a full rule: plans cover it, tasks are governed by it, it carries edges, and `lode show` reads it by its ref. `lode rule accept <ref>` (`POST /api/v1/rules/{id}/accept`) accepts its newest draft version and is gated to the rule's owner. A rule with no owner of its own, such as one minted from a spec section, is owned by the owner of the lowest-id spec arranging it. Accepting a spec still accepts every draft rule the spec arranges.
